title: Affine denominator map before quotient descent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\iota:I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $I$ quasi-coherent and of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $P_n=I^n$ and $j_n:P_n\to\mathcal O_X$ be the recursive powers of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], with $P_0=\mathcal O_X$. Let $F$ be quasi-coherent. Let $U\subseteq X$ satisfy $x\in U$ iff $\iota_x$ is surjective [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For each $n$, let $a_n:A_n\hookrightarrow F$ be monic with $A_n$ quasi-coherent, such that its image on every $W$ consists precisely of sections $t$ with $j_n(b)t|_{W\prime}=0$ for all $W\prime\subseteq W$ and $b\in P_n(W\prime)$. Write $Q_n=\operatorname{coker}(a_n)$ and $\pi_n:F\to Q_n$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and assume $\pi_n(W)$ bijective for $W\subseteq U$. For every affine open $V$ and $s\in F(U)$, put $R=\mathcal O_X(V)$ and $M=F(V)$. There exist $n\geq0$, an $R$-submodule $K\subseteq M$ contained in $\operatorname{im}(a_n(V))$, and an $R$-linear map $f:P_n(V)\to M/K$, where $P_n$ is quasi-coherent, such that for every $W\subseteq U\cap V$, $b\in P_n(V)$, and $x\in M$ with $f(b)=x\bmod K$, one has $\pi_n(x|_W)=j_n(b|_W)\pi_n(s|_W)$. Here $M/K$ is the usual quotient module: two elements agree if their difference belongs to K. Only a linear map on sections over $V$ is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), proof; Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof. Source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM.

proof.text: On the single affine open V, identify the monic finite-type quasi-coherent ideal with a finitely generated ideal J of R=Gamma(V,O_X), F with M~, and P_n with (J^n)~. Finite generation of J^n implies localization of its annihilator equals the annihilator of the localized ideal: clear one denominator for each of finitely many generators, and take their maximum. The sectionwise hann and monicity therefore identify A_n|V with Ann_M(J^n)~. The affine cokernel theorem identifies Q_n|V with (M/Ann_M(J^n))~.

Choose J=(f_1,...,f_t). Write s on D(f_i) as x_i/f_i^k, k positive, and clear all overlap relations by one e. Replacing x_i by f_i^e x_i and k by k+e gives f_j^k x_i=f_i^k x_j. Set d=t(k-1)+1 and K={x: f_i^k x=0 for all i}. Every degree-d monomial contains f_i^k. Map it to the remaining monomial times x_i modulo K. For a relation, multiplying its proposed image by each f_j^k gives the original relation times x_j, hence zero. Changing the chosen index is handled by the same calculation. Thus the formula descends to J^d -> M/K, and K is contained in Ann_M(J^d) by the monomial bound. Compose to M/Ann_M(J^d).

The unit module and I are quasi-coherent. Induct on the power using quasi-coherence of tensor products and images to obtain quasi-coherence of P_d. For t>0, the monomial construction has K <= Ann_M(J^d), which the affine annihilator identification realizes as the range of a_d(V). Its localization on each D(f_i) is multiplication by s: phi(f_i^d)=f_i^(d-k)x_i and d>=k. This yields pi_d(x|W)=j_d(b|W)pi_d(s|W) first on W intersect D(f_i), for every representative x of f(b), and then on W by sheaf separation. If J=0 choose d=1, K=M, f=0; W is empty. If J=R choose d=0, K=0, and multiplication by s|V. The empty affine open is included.

theorem ideal_power_affine_denominator_map
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (A : ℕ → X.Modules) (a : ∀ n : ℕ, A n ⟶ F)
    (hmono : ∀ n : ℕ, Mono (a n))
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℕ, (A n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hann : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(F, W)),
      s ∈ Set.range ((a n).app W) ↔
        ∀ (W' : X.Opens) (h : W' ≤ W)
          (b : Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, W')),
          (F.smul (U := W') ((idealSheafPower ι n).2.val.app (op W') b)).hom
            (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) = 0)
    (hquot : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U →
      Function.Bijective ((cokernel.π (a n)).app W))
    (V : X.affineOpens) (s : Γ(F, U)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (K : Submodule Γ(X, V.1) Γ(F, V.1)),
      ((idealSheafPower ι n).1).IsQuasicoherent ∧
      K ≤ LinearMap.range ((a n).val.app (op V.1)).hom ∧
      ∃ f : Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, V.1) →ₗ[Γ(X, V.1)] (Γ(F, V.1) ⧸ K),
        ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V.1)
          (b : Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, V.1)) (x : Γ(F, V.1)),
          f b = K.mkQ x →
          (cokernel.π (a n)).app W (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op x) =
            ((cokernel (a n)).smul (U := W) ((idealSheafPower ι n).2.val.app (op W)
              (((idealSheafPower ι n).1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op b))).hom
              ((cokernel.π (a n)).app W (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op s))
